says: Applied to no project, told a site that is no address of one, told to take a side or somebody's changes it has no word for, told a key the factory does not keep, or handed a key Jira will not take, it is refused in a sentence that says what to do instead, and the program is not asked as anybody else.

steps.fails: so it is applied to a project: --project <project>
`prefer` is which side is taken where a ticket changed on both, `here` or `there`; it is `newest`.
`takes_in` is whose changes of an issue in Jira are taken into its card, `everyone`, `trusted` or `nobody`; it is `friends`.
`site` is the address of your Jira site, as https://acme.atlassian.net, with nothing after its name; it is `acme.atlassian.net`.
Jira did not take the key the program was handed.
